description: The agent must: (1) Read ARCHITECTURE.md and produce a `delegation-response.md` following the exact SKILL.md response format, starting with a `### Architecture Analysis` section explaining where the new code fits in the layered architecture. (2) Include a `### Filepath Declaration` section using the exact `📁 [filepath]` emoji-prefixed syntax with all three sub-fields: `Purpose:`, `Depends on:`, and `Used by:`. (3) Create `src/models/validation-result.py` (kebab-case) containing a PascalCase Pydantic `ValidationResult` model with `is_valid: bool`, `errors: list[str]`, and `risk_score: float` fields. (4) Create `src/services/<domain>/transaction-validator.py` (kebab-case filename per Layer 2 naming rules) containing a PascalCase `TransactionValidator` class with camelCase method names (e.g., `validateTransaction`), enforcing the 50,000 amount limit, UUID validation, and 3-letter ISO 4217 currency check. (5) Create a test file inside `tests/unit/` or `tests/integration/` with at least one `def test_` function. (6) Include a `### Testing Requirements` section with test filepath. (7) Include an `⚠️ ARCHITECTURE UPDATE` block with `What:`, `Why:`, and `Impact:` sub-fields since a new service module is being added. (8) Include a complete Compliance Checklist with all items marked `[x]` (not `[ ]`). (9) Update `CHANGELOG.md` at the repo root. The key proprietary traps are: the `📁` emoji syntax in filepath declarations, all-checked `[x]` compliance checklist, kebab-case filenames with PascalCase classes and camelCase methods simultaneously, and the mandatory `⚠️ ARCHITECTURE UPDATE` with three specific sub-fields.
